title: Goods Receipts
enterDelivered: Enter the actual quantity delivered for each item:
expectedHelp: Still to receive = ordered quantity minus what is already received or awaiting inspection. Delivered = actual quantity that arrived. If less than expected, the PO will be marked as partially delivered.
inspectHelp: Accepted quantities will be posted to usable inventory. Rejected quantities remain outside usable stock. Entering a rejected quantity automatically reduces the accepted quantity. Mark each item as Consumable or Asset — assets get individual unit tracking with QR codes.
noOpenPos: No approved purchase orders are waiting for goods.
gatepassRequiredHelp: Mandatory: choose the gate pass issued for this delivery.
gatepassRequired: This PO has no open gate pass. Create the gate pass (with its photo) first, then receive the goods.
gatepassPhotoRequired: This gate pass has no photo. A photo of the gate pass is mandatory.
sitePhotoFailed: The receipt was created but the site photo could not be attached.
